Clara: Heads-up - NimbusCare signed up 7 seats for the preview. Only one active user last 10 days. Renewal discussion ~5 weeks after beta ends. Need a short re-engage play.
Owen: Thanks. Which roles are idle?
Clara: Active: 1 eng. Idle: 2 PMs, 2 analysts, 1 data engineer. Onboarding emails opened but no calls.
Yara: Proposal: quick 30m split session - 10m "what success looks like" for PMs, 15m hands-on analyst lab, 5m next steps. Offer optional 1:1 pairing for integration.
Owen: +1. Also send a 2-question pulse: 1) what's blocking you? 2) which session would you prefer? Keep it very short.
Clara: Risk = medium-high. If we don't see +3 active users within 7 days after sessions, escalate to AE and offer engineering pairing.
Yara: I'll prepare the analyst notebook + two sample snippets and propose Wed/Thu slots. Need sandbox from infra.
cs-ops-bot: Sandbox provisioned: nimbus-beta-sandbox (expires in 11 days).

```
Hi NimbusCare team - quick check: noticed some teammates haven't tried the preview. Would a 30m session (10m PM outcomes + 15m analyst lab) or a 1:1 pairing help? Pick a time: <cal.link/nimbus-30m>
```
Clara: Assigning owners: Yara - lab + snippets (due EOD tomorrow). Owen - pulse + buyer outreach (today). Clara - playbook update + renewal tagging.
Yara: Pulse queued. Adding an optional checkbox to request pairing and preferred roles.
Owen: Buyer replied - prefers Thurs 11am. Can we confirm?
Yara: I can do Thurs 11am. Booking now.

```

Agreed success metric: (e.g., 3 active users within 7 days)
Escalation: AE + eng pairing if not met
Owner + due date:
```
Owen: I'll mark renewal risk in Gainsight if no lift in 7 days.
Yara: Will share notebook + snippets in #cs-assets and attach invite.
